title: BUSINESS OF BETTING PODCAST featuring Jacob Fortinsky
body_markdown:
Novig Co-Founder and CEO[Jacob Fortinsky](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ACoAABLJ4pQB-FmhJUr8HcSBdPTGGZPzIyN-IPM) was featured on Business of Betting with Jason Trost. Hear them discuss Novig's recent launch in Colorado, $7 million raise from investors, sports betting as a zero sum game, and much more.
